wolfram.note: Series at Infinity is not implemented: ours stays the call. Wolfram is right, and its Indeterminate is the scan declining to compare a held series, not its answer: Series gives a pair of e^(+-ix) terms with x^(-1/2) and x^(-3/2) coefficients, whose sum agrees with mpmath bessely to 8e-5 at x = 30 and 2e-5 at x = 60.
FunctionRange only classifies elementary shapes. Wolfram's y <= 0.52078641240227 is right (mpmath: the maximum of Y0 on x > 0, at its first zero of Y0').
FunctionRange only classifies elementary shapes. Wolfram's y <= 0.41672992810645 is right (mpmath: the maximum of Y1 on x > 0, at its first zero of Y1').
